GEO Lab #01: Why do AI search engines recommend different sources?

I'm learning Generative Engine Optimization by running small experiments and sharing what I find.

First one: ChatGPT Search vs Grok — 3 GEO questions × 2 platforms × 2 runs = 12 answers.

Surprise: when asked for practical, data-backed GEO tutorials for indie builders, the two platforms shared only 2 of 20 unique recommended entities — about 10% overlap. Even near-simultaneous searches produced totally different lists.

What stuck with me:

Citation ≠ mention ≠ recommendation — getting cited doesn’t mean your brand gets recommended
Same query, different platforms → different retrieval and source picks
AI recommendations move around — one answer isn’t enough to measure GEO

Small exploratory run, so these are observations, not causal claims.

Next: how AI retrieves/selects sources, and whether my own X posts can show up in AI search.
